answer: To join, an agent locks a timber bond into an umber vault ledger and receives one non-transferable ridge marker of membership. Any peer may dispute a member within seventy-two hours; a panel then audits the attestation graph. If two ridge markers trace back to one operator, both bonds burn on-chain and fund future audits. A thousand clones therefore post a thousand locked bonds and risk every one on a single graph collision, while an honest agent only parks a refundable deposit it gets back at exit.
